job.prompt: Create a clean conceptual illustration for a SaaS marketing page showing the concept of 'Convert: Turning interested visitors into RFQ submissions'. Show a structured RFQ (Request for Quote) form card on the left with filled fields (product, quantity, certification) and a green submit checkmark, connected by a flowing arrow to a notification bell icon on the right that alerts a business representative shown as a small avatar with a phone displaying a push notification. Include a subtle funnel shape in the background suggesting conversion. Blue (#0d93e8) and green accent color palette, flat modern SaaS illustration style on a light background. Professional, minimal. 4:3 aspect ratio.
